description: Open an interactive painting labour calculator with current public Oleba price ranges. Omit arguments to let the user fill it in. area_m2 is the measured surface of walls/ceilings being painted, NEVER the apartment floor area. Do not infer it with a multiplier. One painting type per estimate; preparation areas are independent. No materials, no inferred VAT, no binding quote. Does not edit WordPress or contact the company.

area_m2.description: Measured area of painted walls and/or ceilings, not floor area. Omit when unknown.

finish.description: Painting type; defaults to white. Use the same type for all surfaces in this estimate.

name: get_paint_calculator
